# BeingCert

> > BeingCert offers vendor-neutral professional certifications across cybersecurity, software development, cloud, AI/ML, and emerging technologies.

BeingCert is a certification body providing industry-recognized credentials for IT professionals and developers. The platform covers a comprehensive range of domains from traditional software engineering to cutting-edge fields like AI, blockchain, and IoT, with a focus on practical skills and career advancement.

## Key Topics

- Vendor-Neutral Certifications
- Cybersecurity
- Machine Learning & AI
- DevOps & Cloud
- Software Development
- Python
- Docker & Kubernetes
- Blockchain
- IoT
- Penetration Testing
- Secure Coding
- Professional Credentials
- Exam Preparation
- Career Development

## Emerging Technologies & AI

- [Certified AI Professional](https://www.beingcert.com/certification/certified-ai-professional): Certified AI Professional program covering machine learning, deep learning with Python and data tools.
- [Certified Machine Learning Professional](https://www.beingcert.com/certification/machine-learning-certification): Certified Machine Learning Professional (BMLP) covering ML fundamentals, deep learning, and model evaluation.
- [Certified Blockchain Professional](https://www.beingcert.com/certification/certified-blockchain-professional): Certified Blockchain Professional covering Ethereum, Hyperledger Fabric, smart contracts, and Corda.
- [Certified IoT Professional](https://www.beingcert.com/certification/certified-iot-professional): Certified IoT Professional certification covering devices, sensors, security, and networking.

## Cybersecurity & Infrastructure

- [Certified Cyber Security Professional](https://www.beingcert.com/certification/certified-cyber-security-professional): Certified Cyber Security Professional covering cybersecurity fundamentals and network security.
- [Certified Cloud Security Professional](https://www.beingcert.com/certification/certified-cloud-security-professional): Certified Cloud Security Professional (BCCSP) covering cloud computing and security fundamentals.
- [Certified Pentest Professional](https://www.beingcert.com/certification/certified-pentest-professional): Certified Pentest Professional covering penetration testing, ethical hacking, and vulnerability assessment.
- [Certified Secure Coding Professional](https://www.beingcert.com/certification/certified-secure-coding-professional): Certified Secure Coding Professional (BCSCP) covering secure software development practices.
- [Certified Site Reliability Engineer](https://www.beingcert.com/certification/certified-site-reliability-engineer): Certified Site Reliability Engineer covering incident management, system design, and DevOps practices.

## Software Development & DevOps

- [Certified Full Stack Developer](https://www.beingcert.com/certification/certified-full-stack-developer): Certified Full Stack Developer covering MEAN, MERN stacks, React, frontend/backend, and deployment.
- [Certified DevOps Professional](https://www.beingcert.com/certification/certified-devops-professional): Certified DevOps Professional covering Jenkins, Git, Docker, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.
- [Certified Python Developer](https://www.beingcert.com/certification/certified-python-developer): Certified Python Developer (BCPD) professional certification covering Python programming skills.
- [Certified Web Developer](https://www.beingcert.com/certification/certified-web-developer): Certified Web Developer covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and web development fundamentals.
- [Certified Linux Professional](https://www.beingcert.com/certification/certified-linux-professional): Certified Linux Professional covering Linux administration, Docker, Kubernetes, and DevOps.

## Quality Assurance & Testing

- [Certified Software Testing Professional](https://www.beingcert.com/certification/certified-software-tester-professional): Certified Software Testing Professional (BCSTP) covering test automation, performance, and security testing.

## Organization & Overview

- [BeingCert Homepage](https://www.beingcert.com): BeingCert homepage showcasing vendor-neutral certifications in cybersecurity, software, data analytics, and emerging tech.
- [About BeingCert](https://www.beingcert.com/about): BeingCert organization overview covering certification body mission and professional credential offerings.
